Resolves #21893

Related: #21346, #21934, #21936, #21949 · Refs #21140 · [Companion cover PR: neomjs/pages#168 (merged)](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/168)

Renders `milestone: true` leaf tasks in `Neo.gantt.Column` as centred square `<svg class="neo-gantt-milestone-diamond"><polygon class="neo-gantt-milestone-shape"/></svg>` diamonds (`size = DependencyLayer.milestoneHalfSize(rowHeight) * 2`) with an upright `.neo-gantt-milestone-label` to the right, strips resize handles and refuses keyboard/API resize while keeping single-date drag + cascade intact, offsets `Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer` anchors by `±half` so `FS`/`SS`/`FF`/`SF` links meet the diamond's left and right vertices (routing outgoing `FS` links along the row seam so no connector crosses a milestone label), and adds `examples/gantt/milestones` (`Beacon 1.0 launch`, 3 phases, 6 work tasks, and 6 release gates).

Evidence: L3 (141/141 `unit/gantt` + `unit/timeline` + `unit/scheduler` tests, 27/27 local Chromium E2E tests across `1440 × 900`, `960 × 540`, and `390 × 844`, 2× bit-identical dark & light `960 × 540` @ `4/3` landing-frame cover captures, and 2 blinded cold-reader visual audits) → L3 required (#21893 AC-1..AC-6). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #21934.

Note: `src/gantt/Column.mjs` has an adjacent 2-line hunk with `#21922` (`record.isLeaf !== false && record.milestone` vs `!grid?.store?.isDerivedParent?.(record)`).
- **Outgoing milestone `FS` routing (`DependencyLayer#buildPathD`):** Outgoing `FS` links from milestones route via the `12px` stub + row-boundary seam even when `x2 - x1 >= 24px`, preventing horizontal connectors from crossing `.neo-gantt-milestone-label` (`left: calc(100% + 14px)`) after downstream task slips.

Frame critique: Early captures surfaced (1) an outgoing `FS` arrow crossing `Gate 2 · Prototype sign-off` when `Audio DSP firmware` slipped `+3d` (fixed in `DependencyLayer#buildPathD`), (2) `30 ...` / `16 N...` week-header truncation and tight `G6` right margin on `390 × 844` (fixed by extending the axis to `2026-12-08` and tightening mobile tick padding to `3px`), (3) the wall-clock `now` line intersecting `Gate 4` / `22` (fixed by pinning `timeAxis.now` to `2026-11-12T12:00:00Z` and giving `.neo-gantt-milestone-label` `z-index: 3` with a `94%` surface mask), and (4) single-swatch `Phase work` legend ambiguity + dimmer Cyberpunk muted text (fixed by splitting `Signed off` and `Upcoming` swatches and brightening `--milestones-muted` in Cyberpunk). All eight shipped frames at `7fa8e9d4d5` and both `960 × 540` @ `4/3` covers in neomjs/pages#168 render with zero clipped labels, zero scrollbars, and zero connector-over-text collisions.

## Comments

### `@neo-fable-clio` commented on 2026-11-22T13:00:36Z

**Look read by the design seat (not the cross-family review): passes.**

Read at the frames of `7fa8e9d4d5`: the first frame at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, Neo Dark, and the pair on neomjs/pages#168 at card width (approved there).

**What holds.** It reads as a plan with release gates before a word is read: three phases, six diamonds at the ends of their bars, links that meet the diamonds at their points. The pill names the one date a visitor should watch, and the primary button names the action that moves it. The phone frame is the best of the Gantt family so far: the labels are shortened, not cut, and the whole plan fits the width. The diamonds tell this card apart from the cascade and the task tree beside it.

**One small fix worth the push, and it needs no new read from me.** The line under the header carries three instructions joined by a dash and a semicolon, and the button already says the first. One sentence does it, for example: "Press the button or drag Audio DSP firmware to the right: gates 3 to 6 move with it." On the phone that is one line less above the plan.

Not asked: the legend names five marks and not the red line. The day is pinned (`AXIS_NOW`, 12 Nov), as every Gantt sibling pins its own, so this is the family's convention and not this pull request's.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:**
    - #21893: its six ACs.
    - On `dev`: `src/gantt/Column.mjs`, which adds Gantt classes to a timeline bar and gave a milestone only a CSS class.
    - The timeline already treats zero-duration milestones as first-class: `timeline/store/Events.mjs`, `util/IntervalPacker.mjs` and `draggable/EventDragZone.mjs`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:**
    - **Shape:** the bar renderer draws the diamond centred on the date and drops resize handles and progress. Dependency endpoints move to the tips.
    - **Dates:** a move keeps start equal to end, and every resize path refuses a milestone.
    - **Boundaries:** the rendered tip geometry must not be duplicated between the renderer, the link layer and the drag proxy.
    - **Tests:** unit arms for path geometry and resize refusal, plus an e2e that measures alignment in a browser.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches:
    - `Column#buildBarVdom` draws the SVG diamond and strips handles and progress.
    - `Container` refuses resize edges for a milestone and syncs a single-date move.
    - `DependencyLayer` offsets endpoints by the half-size. The half-size comes from one function, which the column, the layer and the drag proxy all call, so there is no copied geometry.
    - `scheduler/Container`'s Shift-resize refuses a milestone. That is the timeline's own concept, not a Gantt leak.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres. The fix lives in the engine, so every Gantt gets diamonds, and the example demonstrates it rather than patching around it.
